goal: Comprehensive reverse-engineering audit of Google Maps Timeline (GMSCore & Maps client) for correctness bugs and performance bottlenecks, formatted into self-contained engineering reports.

steps.description: Deep-dive reverse engineering of GMSCore and GMM bytecode: edit lifecycle, merge algorithm, batch validation, retention trimming, sync, and cleanup jobs
Draft Report 2: Correctness, Data Loss, Midnight Splits, Batch Rules, and Silent Drops (timeline_audit_report_2_correctness_data_loss.md)
Draft Report 3: Sync, Retention Window Clamping, Flash Wear, and Table Mutation Hazards (timeline_audit_report_3_sync_retention_storage.md)
Draft Report 4: Zero-Regression Patch Specification, SQL Migrations, Java Patches, and Verification Suite (timeline_audit_report_4_patch_specification.md)
Incorporate domain feedback: Purposeful monotonicity, legal requirements (tombstones & retention), robust Feature ID architecture, holistic performance audit beyond edits, and Pixel 8 connectivity
